close_reason: Resolved by vjc.10 fix: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS moved before the function doc comment
description: The check_name_constraints function (line 1363) has its doc comment split: lines 1352-1358 form a doc comment, then OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS const definition (lines 1360-1361) interrupts it. Rustdoc attaches lines 1352-1358 to the CONST, not to the function. The function then has no doc comment rendered. This is confirmed by the structure: /// lines immediately before a const = that const's doc. A new contributor reading docs.rs will see no documentation for check_name_constraints.
title: comment at line 1357 is a fragment split from function doc by OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS const
